issues.subject: personal tax relief eligibility for compulsory CPF contributions

retrievalAttempts.pageTitle: IRAS | Central Provident Fund (CPF) Relief for employees

verifiedClaims.quote: Please note that a personal income tax relief cap of $80,000 applies to the total amount of all tax reliefs claimed (including relief on compulsory/voluntary CPF contributions) for each Year of Assessment (YA).
CPF Relief is capped by the amount of compulsory employee CPF contributions made on Ordinary Wages and Additional Wages under the CPF Act.
You may claim CPF Relief for making employee CPF contributions on wages that have not exceeded the Ordinary Wage ceiling and Additional Wage ceiling.
